item.title: Topics to write about - Wishlist
item.description:
This is a small, incomplete list of topics I’d like to write about in the mid- to far future.

  • Caches

  • Interrupts

  • Out-of-Order execution

  • RAW, WAR and WAW conflicts

  • Filters (analog and digital)

  • Analog computers

  • neuronal networks

  • the microbiom

  • the transistor and VLSI
